items.description: AthenaHQ is a generative engine optimization (GEO/AEO) platform that helps brands monitor, measure, and improve their visibility in AI search engines such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews & Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude

The platform combines AI search monitoring/citation tracking, share-of-voice analytics, AI query volume estimation (Query Volume Estimation Model, QVEM), autonomous content agents (Athena Citation Engine, ACE), and revenue attribution
Plans span self-serve, growth, agency, and enterprise tiers, with credit-based usage for monitoring
Built by a team with backgrounds at Google Search and DeepMind
